decisions.reason: The inbound SMS API is close to the core messaging offer and has had its own page for two consecutive years, which suggests results meet aspirations, and a large, growing firm has the slack to carry it at low marginal cost.

The email-to-SMS gateway reuses the existing messaging infrastructure and sits in a growing industry, so there is no evident shortfall to trigger problemistic search, and organisational slack allows it time to prove itself.

The SMS-to-email gateway complements Product B and the integrated communication platform, needs few incremental resources, and has no sign of underperformance, so management has little reason to remove it.
